params.body:
Reads the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#180 writes for `domain`, `ci` and `repo`.

- Domain: the Expires line takes the `expiry` verdict; the 30 and 60 stay as fallback for an older row.
- Tests and CI: Last run takes `run`, Coverage takes `coverage`; the 40 stays as fallback.
- Repo: README misses / README current take `alignment`, Documentation takes `docs`, README takes `readme`; the 100 words stay as fallback.
- One Judged line per card.

Behaviour on current rows unchanged. Two tests in `ThreeSmallCardsTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Either merge order works.
params.title: Domain, Tests and CI, and Repo read Elixir's verdict per facet
